standard_fermion.description: Standard fermionic pair a_1^± satisfying CAR: {a_1^-, a_1^+} = 1

inhomogeneous_deformation.sign_convention: Option A (Issue I05-1): b_j^s * a_1^sigma = a_1^sigma * b_j^s - gb_{sigma,j,s} * kappa

parameters.description: 4n = 8 deformation parameters gb_{sigma,j,s} for sigma in {+,-}, j=1..2, s in {+,-}

inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_projection_note: gamma_matrix records the g-valued projection of the deformation cocycle. κ-contributions that include a scalar K (central identity) component are projected onto g by dropping the K-part. Number of (X,Y,gb) triples with non-zero K component: 42.

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
Aoi (2026), On the triviality of inhomogeneous deformations of osp(1|2n)
